name: FootSettings
doc: Ground-contact setup, serialized in the same animation asset as its chains.

fields.name: probeUp
fields.doc: Probe start above the animated sole in meters.

fields.name: probeDown
fields.doc: Probe reach below the animated sole in meters.

fields.name: soleHeight
fields.doc: Foot-joint height above the ground in meters.

fields.name: pelvisLimit
fields.doc: Maximum pelvis displacement in either vertical direction.

fields.name: minNormalY
fields.doc: Minimum world-up dot ground normal accepted as walkable.
